SYSTEM_PROXY: Set system proxy for this user
SYSTEM_PROXY_ONLY: System proxy · device-wide tunnel is not active
LOCAL_PROXY_ONLY: Local proxy only · Windows settings are unchanged
HTTPS_VERIFIED: HTTPS transfer with TLS verification passed
SELECT_PATH: Select a path. Manual connection does not require a test.
EMPTY_BODY: Import a standard link, Rovunet export or subscription. Unavailable paths are clearly labelled.
ACCOUNT_UNKNOWN: Account status unknown; manual connection is available
ACCOUNT_STALE: Account information is stale or unverified
ACCOUNT_INCOMPLETE: Traffic metering is incomplete or unavailable
IMPORT_HINT: Paste links, a Rovunet text export or subscription JSON. Protected formats require full restriction support before import.
SUBSCRIPTION_HINT: Enter a collection name and subscription URL, then choose Add. Public sources are reviewed before saving.
SINGLE_PROFILE_REQUIRED: Enter exactly one profile to edit
PROBE_HINT: This optional test uses the active proxy. Choose an HTTPS URL. It does not measure UDP, download speed or long-term stability.
HELP_BODY:
1. Add a configuration or subscription.
2. Expand the collection and select a path.
3. Connect; use the separate HTTPS test to check data transfer.
4. Disconnect when finished.

This preview uses the system proxy. It does not cover all apps or UDP. Device-wide TUN is not implemented.
Use Restore proxy for recovery. Settings changed by another app are not overwritten automatically.

Shortcuts: Ctrl+I add, Ctrl+D disconnect, F1 help.
Licences and limitations are included with the installation.

UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT: This format or option is not supported yet
PROTECTED_PROFILE: Protected profile; its security restrictions cannot be removed
ENGINE_NOT_READY: This path engine is not ready for Windows yet
CUSTOM_TRANSPORT_NOT_READY: Custom transport options for this path are not ready yet
XHTTP_EXTRA_NOT_READY: Advanced XHTTP options are not supported yet and are not ignored
HTTPS_REQUIRED: A valid HTTPS URL is required
STATUS_NOT_FOUND: File not found; this does not prove account expiry
FETCH_FAILED: Fetch failed; the URL and previous data have been preserved
PRIVATE_STORE_FAILED: Secure data access failed; do not delete existing data
OS_UNSUPPORTED: This preview requires Windows 10 22H2 or Windows 11 x64
RECOVERY_REQUIRED: Previous settings need recovery; run Restore proxy first
PROXY_RECOVERY_CONFLICT: Another actor changed proxy settings; review the current settings
PROXY_RECOVERY_FAILED: Proxy recovery could not be verified; try recovery again
PROXY_APPLY_FAILED: System proxy setup could not be verified
PROXY_NOTIFY_FAILED: Notifying Windows about proxy changes failed
CORE_START_FAILED: Core startup failed; check configuration and compatibility
ENGINE_HASH_MISMATCH: Core hash does not match the expected version
JOB_FAILED: Core process ownership could not be established
AGENT_FAILED: Connection agent unavailable; check proxy recovery
AGENT_EXITED: Connection ended after a core exit or network change; reconnect when ready
HTTPS_STATUS_FAILED: HTTPS response was not successful; manual connection is preserved
HTTPS_TEST_FAILED: HTTPS transfer was not verified; manual connection is preserved
UNEXPECTED_ERROR: Operation did not complete; use safe diagnostics to investigate
MESSAGE_TOO_LARGE: Internal message exceeds the size limit
KEEP_CURRENT_CONFIRM: Another app or user changed the proxy settings. Keep the current settings and dismiss only the Rovunet recovery record? This does not rewrite network settings.
DELETE_COLLECTION_CONFIRM: Delete all paths in this collection?
SHARING_DISABLED: Sharing is disabled for this profile; no export was created.
EXPORT_SECRET_CONFIRM: This export includes connection details and credentials. Save it securely. Continue?
SETTINGS_HINT: The interface runs without permanent Administrator rights. Device-wide TUN is not implemented yet. System proxy covers compatible apps only.
COLLECTION_TEST_HINT: Paths are tested sequentially with one engine at a time, without changing system proxy. This is an HTTPS test; manual connection stays independent. Stability uses only three short samples.
DNS_HINT: Sends one DNS query for example.com to the entered IP. A DNS response proves neither tunnel authentication nor HTTPS transfer. TCP-only never falls back to UDP.
DNS_REPLIED: DNS replied; tunnel was not tested.
TRANSPORT_START_FAILED: Transport startup failed; check configuration and network access.
DISCOVERY_LIST_NOT_READY: The Android built-in discovery list has not been ported; your imported choice is preserved.
SSH_TRUST_REQUIRED: SSH identity has not been approved.
SSH_KEY_CHANGED: Warning: SSH identity key differs from the saved key.
SSH_TRUST_HINT: Verify the fingerprint with the server operator through a trusted channel. Approve this identity for this profile and retry?
SLIP_CERT_CONFIRM: Have you verified this fingerprint with the server operator for this domain? Save it?
SLIP_CERT_REQUIRED: Choose the public Slipstream certificate in the path menu.
SLIP_CERT_INVALID: A valid, unexpired public PEM certificate is required.
SLIP_VC_REQUIRED: Install Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable x64 for Slipstream.
SLIP_TIMING_HINT: Applies to the next connection on this path. A shorter interval may improve response time and increase DNS traffic.
SLIP_HANDSHAKE_FAILED: Slipstream handshake was not confirmed. Check the certificate and resolver.
CONNECTING_HINT: Starting the path; you can cancel.
DISCONNECTING_HINT: Stopping the engine and restoring the proxy…
ERROR_HINT: Connection did not complete; check the error guidance.
TRAY_HINT: Rovunet stays in the notification area. Use its menu to disconnect and exit.
TRAY_UNAVAILABLE: Notification icon unavailable; closing disconnects the connection.
CLOSE_TO_TRAY: Keep running in notification area when the window closes
SWITCH_PATH_CONFIRM: Disconnect the current path and connect this one?
IMPORT_KEYS: Enter: new line · Ctrl+Enter: import · Esc: cancel
TEST_BUDGET_HINT: Budget per attempt: 10–120 seconds; Slipstream minimum 90 seconds. Cleanup may take 15 more seconds. Tests run sequentially.
TEST_TIMEOUT: Test deadline reached; manual connection has a separate budget.
ACTION_CERT: Choose the trusted public certificate for this domain from the path menu.
ACTION_RECOVER: Run Restore proxy; if settings conflict, review the current Windows settings.
ACTION_CONNECTION: Check the path settings and network access. DNS and HTTPS tests are independent.
STORE_RECOVERY_HINT: Secure data could not be opened. Close to keep it unchanged, or back up the encrypted file and start with an empty list. The proxy recovery journal is preserved.
EXPERIMENTAL_PATH: Experimental path; excluded from normal import
INCLUDE_EXPERIMENTAL: Show and import all paths, including DNS / SSH / Naive
EXPERIMENTAL_HINT: These adapters are not yet verified on your Windows/network. Imported choices and identity checks are preserved.
NO_SUPPORTED_IMPORT: No compatible path in the current mode; existing data is preserved.
SINGLE_IMPORT_HINT: Paste one link or multiple configurations, or choose a file. Only compatible paths are imported.
QR_IMPORT_HINT: Choose a QR image or read a copied image. Review the decoded text in the link tab before importing. The image stays on the device.
QR_TOO_LARGE: Image is too large; choose a smaller image.
LOCAL_OVERRIDE_HINT: This path comes from a subscription. Local edits are retained during subscription updates.
RESET_LOCAL_EDIT_CONFIRM: Discard the local edit and use the last fetched subscription version?
DISCONNECT_EDIT: Disconnect the active path to edit it?
DNS_FINDER_HINT: Enter up to 32 addresses. Four checks run at a time with a 3-second budget. DNS response, tunnel handshake and HTTPS are separate results; a DNS reply alone is insufficient.
DNS_SCAN_LIMIT: Input exceeds the selected limit. Select 1–2048 addresses per run.
DISCONNECT_FOR_TEST: Select a DNS; a separate tunnel test requires the current connection to be disconnected.
TRAFFIC_SCOPE: Bytes through Rovunet in this connection, including automatic tests. Excludes traffic that bypasses the proxy.
RECORDED_SCOPE: Total recorded measurements from this version onward; excludes earlier usage and other device traffic.
HTTPS_LATENCY_SCOPE: Every 30 seconds while connected and the window is active; this is not ICMP ping.
SSH_AUTH_FAILED: SSH username, password or key was rejected
PROBE_PROXY_FAILED: The proxy could not open the test destination
SCAN_HINT_SIMPLE: Check DNS, then establish a tunnel to this server. HTTPS verification is optional.
SCAN_HINT_ADVANCED: Check NS, TXT, EDNS and NXDOMAIN for this tunnel domain.
SCAN_HINT_PRISM: Prism needs a compatible responder. Soar uses authenticated handshakes. Each transport stops at its pass threshold.
SCAN_HINT_E2E: Test HTTPS through each resolver with this profile. The system proxy stays as configured.
SCAN_NEEDS_PROFILE: Import a DNSTT, NoizDNS, Soar, Slipstream or VayDNS profile, then open the resolver finder from its menu.
DNS_SCAN_INVALID: Check scan settings. Workers 1–50, attempts 1–30, threshold up to attempts, response size 0 or 200–4096.
INVALID_RANGE: Enter one or more valid IPv4 CIDR networks.
TCP_CHECK_HINT: This checks a TCP connection to the server. Use the collection HTTPS test to check data transfer.
TCP_NOT_APPLICABLE: No direct TCP endpoint for this route
REGROUP_HINT: These routes share a user and host. Apply these groups?
BUNDLE_LINE_REQUIRED: An Android-compatible bundle requires a single-line link for each profile.
SUBSCRIPTION_IDENTITY_CONFLICT: The subscription reused a profile ID for a different server. Your previous collection was kept. Add the new collection separately.
OVERRIDE_CONFLICT: The panel and local edit changed the same field. Review or reset the edit and update again.
SLEEP_TIMER_HINT: Starts after connecting. Changes apply to the next connection.
GLOBAL_RESOLVER_HINT: DNS tunnel profiles: up to 16 IP addresses with optional ports or HTTPS URLs for DoH, one per line. Save applies to the next connection. An empty list preserves profile settings.
GLOBAL_RESOLVER_NOT_APPLIED: Global resolvers were not applied to this path; using its original profile settings.
DNS_POOL_VERIFY: Verify tunnel and HTTPS before selection
DNS_POOL_HINT: UDP/TCP only: up to 64 endpoints and 4 concurrent probes. Global override takes priority. No usable result preserves the original resolvers; selection is temporary.
DNS_POOL_FALLBACK: No usable pool result; using original profile resolvers.
DNS_SETTINGS: DNS · Changes apply on next connection
ENDPOINT_EDIT_HINT: Credentials and other options are preserved. Open the advanced editor to change them.
OTHER_VERSION_RUNNING: Another copy of Rovunet is running. Choose Exit in its menu, then open this copy.
DNS_BANK_AVAILABLE: {0} offline banks included. Select one using the bank button.
DNS_BANK_UNAVAILABLE: The DNS bank could not be read. Check the application installation.
DNS_BANK_HINT: These banks are included and open without a download. They contain candidate DNS addresses and IP ranges; scanning determines usable results. The scan limit samples part of the selected bank.
DNS_BANK_DOH: This profile uses DoH URLs. IP banks cannot replace its URLs.
GROUP_DNS_SKIPPED: Direct path succeeded; DNS test skipped
SCAN_DOH_SINGLE: This profile supports one DoH URL at a time.
SCAN_SAME_TRANSPORT: Choose DNS servers with the same transport.
SCAN_SELECTION_HINT: Select up to 8 working DNS servers. The selection must share one proven transport.
CORE_SERVER_MATCH: Settings must match the server. Changing a transport here does not change the server.
CORE_COPY_HINT: Saving creates a new profile. The original WebSocket profile stays unchanged.
CORE_NAME_INVALID: Enter a profile name up to 200 characters.
CORE_FIELD_INVALID: Use a single line per field; only JSON may have multiple lines.
CORE_HOST_INVALID: Enter a valid server hostname or IP address.
CORE_AUTH_REQUIRED: Enter the UUID or authentication password.
CORE_UUID_INVALID: Enter a valid UUID with hyphens.
CORE_SNI_INVALID: Enter a valid TLS server name or leave it empty.
CORE_PATH_INVALID: The transport path must start with /.
SSH_KEY_OPTIONAL: Optional: confirm the server fingerprint on first manual connection. Group tests never approve an unknown key.
IDENTITY_FILE_INVALID: The public key or certificate file could not be read.
SSH_KEY_INVALID: Invalid SSH host public key. Paste an OpenSSH public key, not a fingerprint or private key.
NAIVE_START_FAILED: NaiveProxy could not start. Check its Windows runtime and configuration access.
SERVER_IDENTITY_HINT: Paste a verified public host key or public certificate. Changes apply only when you save. Never paste the server private key.
NAIVE_CONFIG_FAILED: NaiveProxy could not read its configuration.
SSH_TLS_CA_PEM: Optional SSH TLS public certificate / CA (PEM)
SSH_TLS_CA_HINT: Only for a private or self-signed TLS certificate. Trust is limited to this server and SNI; name and date checks remain enabled.
TLS_SYSTEM_TRUST: Using the Windows trusted certificate authorities
PROBE_FALLBACKS_HINT: If the configured site fails, try two independent sites through the same tunnel. A successful alternative is shown explicitly; TLS verification stays enabled.
TEST_IDENTITY_PENDING: Test pending: approve SSH identity on manual connect or enter the public host key
PUBLIC_CONSENT: Public content is at your own risk; never enter personal credentials.
PUBLIC_PREVIEW_HINT: Review compatible profiles and rejection reasons before importing.
QR_USE_FILE: This collection is too large for one QR code. Use file export.
SCAN_NEARBY_HINT: After a passing custom IP/range, test neighbours up to 2048 candidates total.
JSON_UNSUPPORTED_OPTION: This outbound contains settings that cannot be preserved.
JSON_OUTBOUND_ONLY: Only compatible outbound profiles are imported. Global DNS, routing and inbound settings are not applied.
PUBLIC_ACCEPT: I agree to fetch and review this third-party source.
PUBLIC_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: Confirm the source choice before downloading.
IMPORT_REVIEW_CONFIRM: Review the results, then press Import again to apply.
SCAN_WHOLE_BANK: Scan every address in the bank
SCAN_WHOLE_BANK_HINT: Default scans the complete address bank. Country ranges use the selected address limit.
SCAN_DNS_STOPPED: DNS scan stopped. Queued tunnel tests continue.
DISCONNECT_SUBSCRIPTION: Disconnect before adding or updating subscriptions.
ADD_HUB_HINT: Use + to add a link, subscription, manual configuration or free connection.
QUOTA_UNIT_HINT: GB = 1,000,000,000 bytes. Account usage includes all devices; it is separate from this app’s traffic counters.
SCAN_SERVER_REACHED: Server reached; HTTPS was not tested
SCAN_FULL_VERIFICATION: Also verify HTTPS through the tunnel
SCAN_FULL_VERIFICATION_HINT: Off checks the authenticated tunnel to this server. On also requests the HTTPS test address through it.
SCAN_SELECTION_LIMIT: Select up to 8 working DNS servers.
EXPORT_FAILED: The file could not be saved.
SCAN_SAVE_LIMITS: Edit the list before saving: up to 16 global DNS addresses or 64 pool addresses in total. Saving to the pool adds addresses and keeps its current on/off setting. Changes apply on the next connection.
SCAN_RESTORED: Scan saved on {0}. Resume unfinished checks or start a new scan. Cached measurements appear gray.
SCAN_NO_MATCHES: No results match these filters yet. The results menu also shows failed checks.
VLESS_ENCRYPTION_INVALID: The VLESS encryption settings or public key are invalid.
CORE_VLESS_ENCRYPTION_HINT: Use none for standard profiles, or paste the complete encryption value supplied by the server.
LOCAL_PROXY_APPS_HINT: Turn off Windows proxy and configure only the apps you want to use this tunnel.
LOCAL_PROXY_PORT_INVALID: Use two different ports from 1 to 65535.
LOCAL_PROXY_PORT_BUSY: A local proxy port is in use. Change it in Settings or close the app using it.
UDP_UPSTREAM_NOT_VERIFIED: UDP support for this configuration has not been verified yet.
BROKER_NETWORK_PATH_LOST: The connection path ended. Check protection and recover before reconnecting.
LOCAL_PROXY_TELEGRAM_MISSING: Telegram could not open. Copy the link or enter the SOCKS5 address in Telegram settings.
LOCAL_PROXY_OTHER_HINT: In the chosen app, open its proxy settings and enter the type, 127.0.0.1 and this port. Choosing an executable does not force its traffic into the tunnel.
LOCAL_PROXY_OPEN_FAILED: The application could not be opened.
LOCAL_PROXY_METHOD_HINT: This tunnel provides SOCKS5 and HTTP proxies. MTProto and WEB need their own compatible server. Apps without proxy support need a separate routing feature.
LOCAL_PROXY_LISTENING: Active local address. These ports remain fixed on the next connection.
LOCAL_PROXY_OFFLINE: Configured address. Connect a profile to activate it.
DNS_LOCAL_HINT: Use DNS addresses from the active Windows network. The profile uses these addresses after saving.
DNS_LOCAL_UNAVAILABLE: No resolver was found on the active network. Enter an address manually.
SCAN_DIRECT_STAGE: Direct tunnel test: counts reflect completed server tests; no separate DNS prefilter is used.
SCAN_TWO_STAGES: Top: resolver response and compatibility. Below: reaching the profile server through that resolver.
SCAN_WAIT_DNS: Tunnel testing becomes available when a resolver meets the minimum score.
SCAN_NO_ELIGIBLE: No resolver meets the tunnel-test criteria. Show all results, check the minimum score, or change the source and scan scope.
SCAN_SAMPLE_SCOPE: A sample of at most {0} addresses will be scanned. Enable Whole bank to scan every address.
SCAN_HINT_SOAR_SIMPLE: Soar: test the server tunnel directly, without a DNS prefilter or a duplicate tunnel test.
TEXT_MOTION_HINT: Long text moves inside its fixed area. Text that fits stays still.
SUP_MIERU_HINT: One server and one port per profile. The transport must match the server.
SUP_TLS_HINT: Certificate validation stays enabled. Leave optional settings empty to use the engine defaults.
DOH_SCOPE_HINT: DoH encrypts DNS lookups. Destination traffic uses ordinary TCP; it can also pass through a previous chain layer. This mode alone does not encrypt all application traffic.
TOR_BRIDGES_HINT: Leave empty for the bundled Snowflake bridges, or enter one supported bridge per line. Connection starts after Tor finishes bootstrapping.
CHAIN_SLIP_OUTERMOST: Slipstream must be the first layer.
CHAIN_LAYER_COUNT: Choose between two and four layers.
TOR_BOOTSTRAP_TIMEOUT: Tor did not finish connecting in time. Try another bridge.
CHAIN_UNSUPPORTED: This combination cannot carry the next connection.
TOR_BOOTSTRAP_FAILED: Tor could not finish connecting. Check the bridges and network.
CHAIN_DUPLICATE_ENGINE: This tunnel family can occur only once. SSH and SOCKS5 can repeat.
XRAY_CHAIN_REQUIRES_OUTER_SSH: An Xray profile can only be used first in a two-layer chain followed by SSH.
CHAIN_HINT: Choose two to four layers in order, from the outer connection to the final exit. Slipstream can only be first; an Xray profile can only be followed by SSH.
TOR_BRIDGE_NOT_SUPPORTED: This Tor bridge type is not supported.
CHAIN_SINGLE_LAYER_ONLY: Choose individual profiles; combined DNS + SSH profiles cannot be chain layers.
ABOUT_LINK_FAILED: The link could not open. You can copy it instead.
ABOUT_SUPPORT_BODY: Rovunet is free; voluntary donations help further development.
MAHSA_DECODE_FAILED: Mahsa data could not be decoded. Existing profiles were kept.
MAHSA_VALIDATION_FAILED: Some Mahsa profiles are invalid or incompatible. The saved collection was not changed. Review the rejection reasons in the preview.
PUBLIC_SOURCE_MANAGED: The source address is managed inside the app.
PUBLIC_SOURCE_REMOVED: This source has been removed from the app.
APP_UPDATE_VIA_TUNNEL: Check and download through the active tunnel
APP_UPDATE_READY: Check for a newer Windows release.
APP_UPDATE_CURRENT_OK: You have the newest available Windows version for this channel.
APP_UPDATE_AVAILABLE: A newer Windows version is available.
APP_UPDATE_DOWNLOADED: Download complete. The file hash matches GitHub. The installer has not been run.
APP_UPDATE_INTEGRITY_NOTE: Windows x64 · Beta and stable releases. Download integrity is checked against GitHub. Publisher signing is a separate check; installation does not start automatically.
APP_UPDATE_NETWORK_FAILED: The update server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
APP_UPDATE_METADATA_INVALID: Update details are missing or invalid. The download was stopped.
APP_UPDATE_INTEGRITY_FAILED: The downloaded file does not match its expected size or hash. Your previous file was kept.
APP_UPDATE_REDIRECT_REJECTED: The download redirected to an unapproved address. It was stopped.
APP_UPDATE_ROUTE_CHANGED: The connection changed. Please check again before downloading.
APP_UPDATE_ARCH_UNSUPPORTED: No compatible Windows update is available for this architecture.
CONNECTION_DATA_CONFIRMED: Connection established; data has passed through this connection.
ACCOUNT_BINDING_CHANGED: The subscription account identity changed. Previous data was retained.
